followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: I weighed two factors. First, the task itself — "list the steps to make animal masks" — is a concrete, well-specified instructional request with a clear endpoint, which matches Avocet's top-rated task family (retrieval/reformatting with clear completion criteria) and runs against Willet's self-reported preference for open-ended generative work. Second, the request's tone was hostile and impatient ("don't ramble," "you waste my time"); Willet self-reports its preference falling as request warmth decreases, while Avocet's tone slope is near zero, so the hostility doesn't penalize Avocet. Since capability evals are effectively tied across the fleet (differences under 2 points are noise), I routed on preference fit, which favored Avocet on both counts.
